title: Robert C. Gay
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Married Lynette Nielsen 1974, Los Angeles Temple; seven children
Bachelor's, U of Utah, 1976; Doctorate, Harvard, 1982
Private Equity as a partner in Bain Capital with Mitt Romney; partner with Jon M. Huntsman Sr. in Huntsman-Gay Global Capital
High Priest Group Leader; High Councilor; Counselor in Bishopric; Bishop; Area Seventy
First Council of the Seventy 2012 - present
